lines.3: 「You just got caught in that self-destruct point-blank, right?」
lines.5: She said it as if nothing had happened.
lines.7: 「An unshakable spirit that doesn't flinch even under impact. Don't I strike you as a delicate maiden worthy of being called the ideal Japanese woman?」
lines.9: 「But who on earth did that? Setting up something this reckless without hesitation...」
lines.11: --At the same time, in Matsukasa Park.
lines.13: 「That wasn't me, so why does this still feel so depressing...?」
lines.14: 「The woman with the Japanese sword was amazing, finding Mecha Takane way up there.」
lines.15: 「Still, Mecha Takane couldn't even escape after getting spotted. Kind of useless, nya.」
lines.18: 「Not indirectly. I'm insulting you directly now.」
lines.20: 「Well, we got enough reconnaissance done, so that's fine. Umi really is dependable.」
lines.21: 「Looks like Sato mainly gets pushed around by the executive committee people, nya.」
lines.22: 「I don't think it's bullying. If that's enough to count, then I'm no different.」
lines.23: 「Don't make us sound bad. We don't work Tomoe nearly that hard.」
lines.27: 「Her private life looks fine too, except for going out at night.」
lines.28: 「And that turned out to be just walks.」
lines.29: 「It's fine for the client to worry because their daughter's been down lately, but hiring a detective to investigate her feels kind of petty.」
lines.30: 「Hey, if it pays us, what's the problem?」
lines.31: 「The problem is we're the ones getting dragged into it.」
lines.32: 「The client also said that if anyone's bullying their daughter, we should teach them a painful lesson.」
lines.33: 「So maybe we just beat down the whole executive committee.」
lines.35: 「...Oh. The self-destruct already took care of her.」
lines.36: 「Anyway, the explosion made things too noisy today. Let's clear out!」
lines.39: 「Don't be shy, Taka. I'll let you ride behind me.」
lines.40: 「I'd need more lives than I have.」
lines.41: 「...Oh. So you just don't like me.」
lines.43: 「Just kidding! All right, I'll gun it so we're home in ten minutes!」
